न्यग्रोध

NYAGRODHA . A son of ugrasena. When kṛṣṇa killed kaṁsa nyagrodha fought with kṛṣṇa and others and was killed by the blow of Balabhadra's shield. (bhāgavata).

न्यग्रोधतीर्थ

NYAGRODHATĪRTHA . A holy place on the banks of the ancient river dṛṣadvatī in North india. (Vana Parva, Chapter 90, Verse 11).
